one_liner: WooCommerce is a self-hosted WordPress store plugin with a broad REST API (wc/v3) authenticated by merchant-generated consumer key/secret; no central OAuth2 for REST, so each store needs its own setup. Vendor docs also describe MCP integration.
auth_notes: Merchants generate a Consumer Key/Secret per store in WP admin (linked to a WP user, with read/write permissions); docs show them used as HTTP Basic username/password. The MCP path uses WordPress Application Passwords (remote proxy) or WordPress.com OAuth (WooCommerce AI MCP server), but these are not the REST API's auth, so they are not added to auth_methods. No OAuth 2.0 is documented for the REST API itself.
access_notes: Any store admin can create keys in WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API; no application or approval step appears in the docs. Needs pretty permalinks, and the base URL is per-store. The pages do not explicitly state that the software is free.
blocker_notes: Each merchant runs their own store at their own URL, so users must supply the store URL and manually generate consumer key/secret. There is no central OAuth app for the REST API.

evidence.quote: For Authorization, choose **basic auth** and enter your **consumer key** and **consumer secret** keys from WooCommerce into the username and password fields.
Copy the **Consumer Key** and **Consumer Secret** and enter them in the application you are connecting to.
Go to **WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API**.
To start using REST API, you first need to generate API keys.
This allows WC data to be created, read, updated, and deleted using requests in JSON format and using WordPress REST API Authentication methods and standard HTTP verbs

WooCommerce registers product and order abilities in WordPress. With the MCP Adapter plugin, AI clients can discover and run these store operations through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), subject to WordPress and WooCommerce permissions.
The WordPress.com connection uses OAuth on first use; this path does not require copying a WooCommerce consumer secret into the client configuration.
